title: Outbreak
description: Every [blue]10[/blue] times you apply [gold]Poison[/gold], deal damage to ALL enemies.
notes: Tracks poison applications as a counter (0-2 before reset). Triggers damage to all enemies when 3 poison applications are made by the owner, with damage based on the power's configured Amount value. Note: The localization description states 10, but the code threshold is 3 (this may be a localization version mismatch).
